answer: Each new agent ID has to post a bond of 50 tokens, and that bond stays locked for 30 days. If peers catch two IDs signing from the same key or the same timing pattern, both bonds are slashed. A thousand sybils would tie up 50,000 tokens, which is an ocean of capital for a farm of fake voters. A bot that tries to wander between wallets to hide gets flagged by the ferrous chain of linked deposits, because every refund goes back to the address that funded it.
